subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should preset session marks become a second built-in core labeling command, or should `/name` remain the sole core label primitive with presets implemented through a plugin or UI action?
rationale: The PR adds permanent command and session-state semantics for convenience already expressible through `/name`; code review cannot determine whether that additional core surface matches maintainer product intent.

options.title: Keep one core label primitive
options.body: Retain `/name` as the core contract and prototype preset ergonomics through a plugin or UI action, opening a core API discussion only if the extension seam proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor core `/mark`
options.body: Accept a distinct built-in command, then require a current-main rebase, collision-safe encoding, lifecycle tests, and fresh real behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep one core label primitive
recommendation.body: Retain `/name` as the core contract and prototype preset ergonomics through a plugin or UI action, opening a core API discussion only if the extension seam proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the recent merged work on `/name` label persistence across session lifecycle transitions.
